summary: Restoration pledges include 6,000 ha of reforestation and 4,000 ha of assisted forest regeneration, plus rehabilitation of at least 20% of degraded sites. Conservation combines 5,000 ha of avoided deforestation with protection of at least 20% of terrestrial and marine natural ecosystems, reserves covering at least 25% of national territory, and sustainable management of 50% of natural ecosystems. Agriculture targets 1,000 ha of rice-crop methane reduction and 4,537 ha of conditional agro-industry promotion. Mixed measures range from a 70,000-ha carbon-sink pilot to an unconditional plan for 158,640 ha of afforestation and 63,500 ha of agroforestry; additional support would enable 67,520 ha and 16,667 ha, respectively. Named projects cover 40,000, 50,000, 102,000 and another 50,000 ha of plantations, plus 102,560 ha of agro-industry. The unconditional afforestation plan equals about 0.55% of current forest cover, while the planned agroforestry equals about 2.10% of current agriculture.
